recipes.name: Braised Chuck Roast
steps: Salt the roast and sear on all sides in a Dutch oven.
Sauté onion, carrots and garlic; add tomato paste, broth and herbs; return the roast.
Braise covered at 300F 2.5-3.5 h until fork-tender.
Shred or slice; reduce the sauce.
recipes.notes: Improves on day 2; freezes 3-4 months. Bigger roasts add about 30-45 min per extra 2 lb; keep liquid at half the height of the meat.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
steps: Season the roast; place on the vegetables in the slow cooker.
Add broth and Worcestershire.
Cook LOW 8-10 h until shreddable.
recipes.notes: Fill the slow cooker only half to two-thirds.

recipes.name: Beef and Bean Chili
steps: Brown beef with onion and pepper; drain half the fat.
Add garlic and spices 30 seconds, then tomatoes and beans.
Simmer 40 min.

recipes.name: Beef Taco Bowls
steps: Brown the beef; add seasoning and water; simmer 3 min.
Assemble bowls with rice, beans, corn and salsa.
recipes.notes: Use 80/20 and drain if you prefer more flavor.

recipes.name: Flank Steak and Broccoli Stir-Fry
ing: flank steak, sliced thin against the grain
steps: Toss steak with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy; rest 15 min.
Sear in a very hot pan 1-2 min per side, in batches; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, ginger and garlic 3 min; return steak with remaining soy and honey.
recipes.notes: Slice against the grain so it stays tender.

recipes.name: Marinated Grilled Flank Steak
steps: Marinate steak 2-6 h.
Grill on high 3-5 min per side to 130-135F.
Rest 10 min; slice thin against the grain.
recipes.notes: USDA safe temperature is 145F; medium-rare carries some risk.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Steak with Garlic Butter
ing: sirloin or ribeye steak, 1 in thick
steps: Salt the steak 30-60 min ahead and dry it well.
Sear in a very hot oiled pan 3-4 min per side.
Add butter, garlic and thyme; baste 1 min; pull at 125-135F; rest 5-10 min.
recipes.notes: Thicker steaks: reverse-sear at 250F to 10-15F below target first.

recipes.name: Shepherd's (Cottage) Pie
steps: Boil potatoes 15-20 min; mash with milk, butter and 1 tsp salt.
Brown beef with onion and carrots; add tomato paste, broth and peas; simmer 10 min.
Top with mash; bake 400F 25 min until browned.

recipes.name: Baked Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix gently and roll 1.5 in balls.
Bake at 400F 18-20 min to 160F.
Simmer in marinara 10 min.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
ing: beef sirloin or flank, sliced thin
steps: Sear beef in batches 1-2 min per side; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli 3 min with garlic.
Whisk soy, sugar, cornstarch and broth; add with beef; cook until glossy.

recipes.name: Smash Burgers
steps: Divide beef into 8 balls.
Smash flat on a very hot griddle; season; cook 2 min; flip, add cheese, cook 1 min.
Stack on buns.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Carnitas
steps: Toss pork with salt and spices; add to the slow cooker with juices, onion and garlic.
Cook LOW 8-10 h (or pressure 60-75 min) until 195-205F and shreddable.
Shred and crisp under the broiler 3-5 min with some juices.

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork
steps: Rub pork with sugar, spices and salt; place in the slow cooker with the vinegar.
Cook LOW 8-10 h.
Shred, discard fat, and toss with juices and BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Brined Pan-Seared Pork Chops
steps: Brine chops 30 min; dry well.
Sear 4-5 min per side; baste with butter, thyme and garlic.
Pull at 145F and rest 3 min.

recipes.name: Roast Pork Tenderloin
steps: Remove silverskin; season and coat with mustard.
Sear 2 min per side; roast at 425F 12-18 min to 145F; rest 5 min.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Vegetables
steps: Toss vegetables with oil, salt and seasoning; roast 425F 10 min.
Add sausages; roast 20-25 min more to 160F.

recipes.name: Pork Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, rice and pork; add soy; fold in eggs and sesame oil.
recipes.notes: Uses leftover pulled pork or roast pork.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Chili
steps: Brown turkey with onion; add pepper, garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and beans; simmer 30-40 min.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Mix and roll into balls; bake at 400F 18 min.
Simmer in sauce 10 min to 165F.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Taco Meat
steps: Brown turkey in a hot skillet, leaving it 1-2 min to brown, then break up; cook to 165F.
Stir in seasoning and broth; simmer 2 minutes.
recipes.notes: 93/7 needs the added liquid to stay moist.

recipes.name: Juicy Turkey Burgers
steps: Mix gently and form 4 patties with a thumbprint dimple.
Cook 5-6 min per side to 165F.

recipes.name: Roast Turkey Breast
steps: Salt the turkey 12-24 h ahead.
Rub with butter, herbs and garlic; roast at 325F 1.5-2 h to 165F in the thickest part.
Rest 20 min before slicing.
recipes.notes: Great cold-cut meat for the week.

recipes.name: Braised Turkey Thighs
steps: Salt and brown the thighs; remove.
Sauté vegetables; add broth and thyme; return thighs.
Braise covered at 325F 2-2.5 h until tender.
recipes.notes: Cheap dark meat; shred for bowls.

recipes.name: Beef or Lamb Kofta
steps: Mix and shape onto skewers.
Grill or broil 8-10 min, turning, to 160F.
recipes.notes: Serve with yogurt sauce and rice.
